title: CAB450M12XM3 1200 V, 450 A all-SiC conduction-optimized half-bridge module (XM3) data sheet, Rev. A, 2019-06-01
method: Table values copied from the datasheet text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). Distributor-hosted (Farnell) copy of the Wolfspeed PDF; the newer Wolfspeed-hosted revision (assets.wolfspeed.com/uploads/2024/01/Wolfspeed_CAB450M12XM3_data_sheet.pdf) could not be fetched (request blocked), so values are from Rev. A and may differ from the current revision. Z_th(t) is given only as a graph (Fig. 17); no Foster/Cauer r_i/tau_i in the datasheet text. Wolfspeed distributes 4th-order Cauer parameters separately (Cauer_Network_Parameters.xlsx in the SPICE RC thermal model zip, per PRD-09035 Rev. 1), not fetched. R_thCH not stated. T_vj op max taken from 'TVJ op ... -40 175 C (maximum virtual junction temperature under switching conditions)'.

mosfet.I_D_note: V_GS 15 V, T_C 90 C, T_VJ <= 175 C (Note 2: computed from R_thJC 0.11 C/W and R_DS(on) 4.6 mOhm); 450 A at T_C 25 C
mosfet.I_DM_note: I_DS(pulsed), t_P max limited by T_J max; I_SD(pulsed) 900 A at V_GS 15 V, T_C 25 C
mosfet.R_DSon_cond: V_GS 15 V, I_D 450 A (devices); 25 C typ 2.6 / max 3.7, 175 C typ 4.6
mosfet.E_cond: V_DS 600 V, I_D 450 A, V_GS -4/15 V, R_G(ext) 0.0 ohm (R_G(int) 2.5 ohm), L 13.6 uH (inductive clamped load)
mosfet.V_SD_cond: body diode, V_GS -4 V, I_SD 450 A

E_cond_num.note: E_cond 문자열의 시험 전압·전류를 숫자로 옮김(E37)
